Privacy Policy

Effective Date: September 15, 2025 (Updated: February 9, 2026) Organization: Rifat Academy Website: www.rifatacademy.com

At Rifat Academy, protecting the privacy and security of your personal information is our top priority. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our website and our Google Sign-in services.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information to provide a better learning experience. This includes:

  • Personal Information: Full name, email address, and profile picture.

  • Google User Data: When you choose to sign in via Google, we access your Google public profile information (name and email) and profile picture to create and manage your account securely.

  • Technical Information: IP address, browser type, device type, and access times collected through log files or cookies.

  • Communication Data: Information you provide when contacting us for support.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected data for the following purposes:

  • To facilitate secure login via Google OAuth.

  • To create and maintain your student profile on Tutor LMS.

  • To provide support and respond to your inquiries.

  • To send important updates regarding your enrolled courses.

  • To prevent fraud and ensure the security of our platform.

3. Google Data Disclosure (Limited Use)

Rifat Academy’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to Google API Service User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. We do not sell, trade, or use your Google data for advertising purposes.

4. Data Security & Retention

  • Encryption: Passwords and sensitive data are stored in an encrypted format.

  • Protection: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect against unauthorized access.

  • Retention: We only keep your personal data as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you with our educational services.

5. Your Rights & Consent

By using Rifat Academy and signing in through Google, you acknowledge and agree to this Privacy Policy. You have the right to:

  • Request access to the data we hold about you.

  • Request the deletion of your account and associated data at any time.

6. Contact Us

If you have questions or need assistance regarding your privacy or data deletion, please contact us:

  • Phone: 09611900584

  • Website: www.rifatacademy.com
